baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِتَابٌ at word 3 and تَدْرُسُونَ at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book is an ordered written object, and study is repeated reading that makes its contents retained and traversable.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies an actually inscribed textual object made from ordered letters.
Repeated reading and retention supply the reader's ongoing operation within that object.

changed_reading.before: You possess a book and read it.
changed_reading.after: You would need an actually inscribed curriculum whose contents you repeatedly follow and retain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal كِتَابٌ and the activity تَدْرُسُونَ form an authority-and-consultation construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book can be a binding determination rather than merely stored information; repeated study makes it a continually consulted source of judgment.

activation_trace.role: The branch of binding inscription supplies decree, obligation, or judgment as the book's force.
Repeated reading turns the decree into a rule repeatedly consulted and internalized.

changed_reading.before: The book contains material to learn.
changed_reading.after: The question asks for a binding determination that can actually be consulted as the source of the claimed judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِتَابٌ can record standing or terms, while تَدْرُسُونَ checks that record repeatedly.
baseline_models.mechanism: A book may place names in a roster or embody a release contract, so studying it becomes verification of status, inclusion, and terms rather than acquisition of doctrine.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register supplies recorded membership and standing.
The manumission-contract branch supplies a status-changing deed with performable terms.
Repeated reading supplies verification and rehearsal of the recorded terms.

changed_reading.before: The addressees own a religious text.
changed_reading.after: They would need a status-bearing register or deed that records their inclusion or release and whose terms can be verified.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The book's assembled surface at word 3 is traversed by the د ر س action at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Study can be repeated contact that both follows a mark and wears it down; the reader works from a surviving trace rather than receiving pristine propositions.

activation_trace.role: Joining pieces supplies the compiled surface on which traces are gathered.
The effaced-trace branch makes studying an act of retracing what is partly disappearing.
Worn fabric supplies the material effect of repeated handling and use.

changed_reading.before: Study retrieves stable content from a book.
changed_reading.after: Study may be forensic retracing of a compiled but fading surface whose use has itself altered the evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening places inscription in active production, while 68:47 repeats the challenge and turns the same book root into their act of writing from a claimed hidden source. The possessed book can therefore be a recursively manufactured warrant whose authors rehearse their own lines until those lines feel external.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the written artifact whose authorship is put in question.
Repeated reading supplies the rehearsal by which self-produced claims can become internally authoritative.
The prepared writing instrument places textual authority inside a visible production process.
Ordered written rows supply the produced lines that precede the focus book.
The false-legends branch makes their relabeling of recited signs an editorial act within the loop.
Concealment from sight supplies the inaccessible source their later writing pretends to command.
The later writing verb turns the focus's static-looking book back into an authored product.

structural_cues: The surah opens with pen and ongoing inscription, while 68:47 repeats the أم...لهم challenge and ends with their writing.
At 68:15 recited signs are verbally recatalogued as old stories, displaying an interpretive act that renames the textual evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pen, written rows, their old-stories label, hidden knowledge, and their act of writing; I infer a loop in which they manufacture and rehearse the authority they claim. The live alternative is that 68:1 and 68:47 concern separate writing acts and leave 68:37 as an external scripture.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether an external book supports them.
changed_reading.after: The question may expose a closed authorship loop: they write or relabel a warrant, repeatedly study it, and then cite their own inscription as independent authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context joins material wear to a test that reveals condition. That pairing turns the focus's repeated study into reciprocal exposure: use wears the textual surface, but the encounter also discloses what kind of reader is using it.

activation_trace.role: Repeated reading supplies sustained contact between reader and text.
The worn-fabric branch supplies alteration produced by repeated use.
Wear from use mirrors the material effect already latent in the focus verb.
A test that reveals condition converts textual friction into disclosure of the reader.

structural_cues: The garden narrative begins by naming a test and then converts confident planning into exposed moral condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reading, wear, and testing that reveals a state; I infer that the text tests its user through the same repeated contact by which the user studies it. The alternative is a looser lexical resonance between unrelated kinds of wear.

changed_reading.before: Studying means the reader progressively masters the book.
changed_reading.after: The repeated encounter can instead test and expose the reader; while they study the book, the book effectively reads their disposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus register and threshing branches meet a story organized by allotted shares, harvest, withheld benefit, and eventual deprivation. The book becomes a distributive ledger, and study becomes the processing that separates claims and beneficiaries as grain is processed from a crop.

activation_trace.role: The register branch supplies a record that can include or exclude named beneficiaries.
Threshing underfoot supplies the surprising processing image for separating usable shares.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies exclusion from distribution.
Division into allotted shares supplies the ledger's distributive operation.
Harvesting date palms supplies the material yield whose ownership is being allocated.
Gathering, gain, and work supply the economic product processed by the model.
Loss of the desired share reverses the owners' attempted exclusion onto themselves.

structural_cues: The garden owners swear to harvest, move to exclude the poor, and finally identify themselves as deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registration, threshing, allocation, harvest, withholding, and deprivation; I infer one distributive mechanism and transfer the material processing of grain to the adjudication of shares. The live alternative is that the agricultural and documentary domains should remain separate.

changed_reading.before: The book would contain doctrinal evidence for a judgment.
changed_reading.after: The book may be the imagined share-register by which they process entitlement and exclude claimants, a mechanism the garden reversal exposes as false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judgment precedes the book question and unrestricted choosing follows it. The sequence turns study from receptive learning into outcome-driven extraction: the desired result is selected first and the book is treated as the device that must yield it.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the kind of authority their preferred judgment would require.
Repeated reading supplies the procedure that can be bent into motivated searching.
Judging between people supplies the disputed output immediately before the focus.
Choosing what is sought supplies the preference that drives extraction from the alleged book.

structural_cues: The three-ayah sequence is: how do you judge, do you have a book you study, and does it contain whatever you choose?
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judicial output, repeated study, and unrestricted selection; I infer the arrow from prior preference to selective textual extraction. The live alternative is honest study of a book that independently happens to promise the chosen outcome.

changed_reading.before: A book neutrally supplies the rule from which judgment follows.
changed_reading.after: The alleged book is a preference engine: they study toward a selected conclusion and then present the extracted conclusion as binding judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's contract branch is followed by binding oaths that reach a stated endpoint and by demand for a guarantor. This makes the book an enforceable status-changing deed whose claimed beneficiary must produce both durable terms and surety.

activation_trace.role: The manumission contract supplies a deed that changes status after enforceable performance.
Repeated reading supplies examination of the deed's terms.
The oath branch supplies a binding undertaking from the alleged counterparty.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the undertaking's asserted duration and completion.
Bearing surety supplies the guarantor needed to make the claimed deed answerable.

structural_cues: The repeated لكم shifts to أيمان علينا and then to a demand that one of them stand as guarantor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a release contract, oath, endpoint, and surety; I infer an enforceable deed that grants the addressees protected status. The live alternative is a general covenant or scripture, since the manumission scope may specify the legal analogy more narrowly than the construction warrants.

changed_reading.before: The book is a general register or legal text concerning their standing.
changed_reading.after: The book becomes their alleged deed of release, backed by an oath and guarantor and claimed to remain effective through the final endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later calls demand a bodily response, and hearing the reminder carries the branch of understanding with compliance. Study therefore migrates from page to trained body: retention is evidenced by readiness to answer, while inability to bow reveals that textual familiarity never became formation.

activation_trace.role: Repeated reading and retention supply a practice capable of forming response.
The spoken call supplies the occasion on which retained teaching must become action.
Bodily members and the trace of prostration supply the inscription of learning into posture.
Understanding joined to compliance distinguishes transformative hearing from bare reception.
Recollection with retention supplies the internal availability expected from genuine study.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 repeat the call to prostration and contrast present inability with an earlier call made while they were able.
68:51-52 move from hearing the reminder to naming it as reminder for all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated study, a call, bodily trace, compliant hearing, and retention; I infer that true study trains an answerable body. The live alternative is that documentary proof and ritual incapacity are separate accusations rather than one pedagogy.

changed_reading.before: Studying the book means knowing what its sentences say.
changed_reading.after: Studying the book means being formed into a responder; failure of embodied response shows that possession and recitation never became retained obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse renews, takes them degree by degree, and then uses a form whose inventory holds both extension of time and dictation of a book before returning to their writing. Respite can thus be read as an unfolding dictation: lived time generates the record they fail to recognize while inside it.

activation_trace.role: The written-book branch supplies the record into which unfolding events can be inscribed.
Repeated study supplies the later act of recognizing and retaining an accumulated record.
Renewing discourse supplies text that continues to happen rather than remaining a static archive.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the serial pacing of the record's production.
Extension of time supplies the lived interval in which the record develops.
Dictation of a book supplies the latent textual action carried by that temporal extension.
What is concealed from sight explains why agents inside the unfolding record mistake it for mere delay.
The explicit return to writing closes the movement from duration back into text.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from this discourse, to gradual taking, to extended time, and then to a question about hidden knowledge and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewing speech, graded movement, temporal extension, dictation, concealment, and writing; I infer that conduct during respite is being composed into an intelligible record. The live alternative is that the dictation branch is only a distant lexical neighbor and that the verse means delay without textual production.

changed_reading.before: A completed book already exists outside the addressees for them to inspect.
changed_reading.after: They may already inhabit the book's dictation: extended time writes their trajectory degree by degree, and study would mean recognizing the accumulating record before its completion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant images of a trimmed lot and a vessel of lots around ordinary pen and Lord forms. It remains anchored in the focus book as an assembled collection and in study as interpretation, while 68:38 supplies explicit selection. Render it only as a material analogy for arbitrary selection masquerading as textual judgment, not as a replacement gloss for any source word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كِتَابٌ as an assembled collection and تَدْرُسُونَ as repeated interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Joining items supplies a collection from which an item might be drawn.
Repeated reading supplies interpretation and rehearsal of the selected result.
A prepared stick cast as a lot turns the writing instrument into a selection device.
A vessel gathering lot-sticks supplies the container that organizes the drawing.
Seeking a preferred choice supplies the outcome-driven use of the apparatus.

changed_reading.before: The book is a stable written authority from which a verdict is learned.
changed_reading.after: The alleged book can be pictured as a bundle of lots: a preferred outcome is drawn, interpreted, and then presented as if the text had independently decreed it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links nonliteral path and surface branches across widely separated ayat. It remains anchored in the focus verb's effaced-path image and the book's textual location. Render it as a qualified material analogy for unstable interpretive footing, not as a claim that study lexically means compromise or slipping.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَدْرُسُونَ at word 5 as following a path whose trace can be effaced within the book.

activation_trace.role: A hidden or effaced path makes study the attempt to keep textual footing on a fading trace.
The extended traversable road supplies the stable guidance-path against which effacement is measured.
A smoothed path turns conciliatory polishing into loss of useful texture.
A smooth place on which feet cannot hold supplies the terminal instability of the over-smoothed path.

changed_reading.before: Repeated study stabilizes a reliable path through the book.
changed_reading.after: Repetition joined to conciliatory smoothing may efface the path until the claimed textual footing becomes too slick to bear judgment.

strongest_changes: The alleged book becomes a preference-driven warrant rather than a neutral curriculum.
Oath, endpoint, and surety sharpen the status instrument into an alleged enforceable release deed.
The writing frame supports two competing authorial readings: a warrant they recursively write for themselves, and a record dictated through the time they inhabit.
Study can test and form the reader, with bodily response serving as evidence of retention.
The garden sequence activates an exploratory distributive ledger in which shares are processed, withheld, and reversibly lost.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots bridge textual, legal, material, and agricultural mechanisms. Context does not merely identify the book; it alternately makes the book an authored artifact, binding decree, status deed, selective engine, share-ledger, reader-testing surface, embodied curriculum, and temporally unfolding record.
remaining_uncertainties: The wear, threshing, lot, and slick-path models depend on cross-domain branch transfer and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The manumission-contract branch may specify release more narrowly than the surrounding oath and guarantor language requires.
The dictation reading depends on carrying a non-dominant sense of temporal extension into textual production.
The self-authored warrant and time-dictated record point in opposite authorial directions; both mechanisms remain live rather than being reconciled.
